Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Updated default gear keyword price caps: Ceremonial 18,000; Archeo Kingdom 15,000; Diadochus 13,000; Rinascita 11,000; Classical 10,000. Existing configs still on the previous default prices migrate automatically; custom edited keyword prices are preserved.
